plan.title: Closed RFQ Extend Submission Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing its Settings menu.
Open the Increase Event Time window without confirming a time change.
Assert that the expected time-extension window opened.
Assert that the window offers exactly the expected time choices.
Assert that the dialog provides a Cancel button.
Assert that the dialog provides an Ok button.
